title: AEOeye vs Quattr: Free Instant AI-Visibility Audit vs Enterprise SEO+AEO+GEO Platform
metaDescription: AEOeye vs Quattr compared fairly: a free, instant, blind multi-engine AI-visibility audit versus a demo-gated enterprise SEO+AEO+GEO platform with a GIGA
shortAnswer: AEOeye gives you a free, instant, blind audit of how ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI, Claude, and Gemini answer your buyers' real questions — no account, no demo, no contract, results in seconds. Quattr is a heavier enterprise SEO+AEO+GEO platform whose GIGA AI agent doesn't just track visibility but executes fixes (content, internal links, CMS-ready HTML), with demo-gated pricing and a real onboarding investment. Choose AEOeye to see where you stand right now and decide what's worth fixing; choose Quattr if you're an enterprise or agency team that wants an integrated insight-to-execution workflow and can commit to the setup and budget.
intro: These two tools get lumped together because both touch "AI search visibility," but they solve different problems and meet you at different moments. AEOeye answers a single, urgent question — *when my buyers ask AI which tool to use, does my brand even come up?* — and answers it for free, in seconds, across five engines, with nothing to install and no call to book.\n\nQuattr is a bigger animal: an enterprise-grade SEO, AEO, and GEO platform built to take a marketing or SEO team from insight all the way to deployed changes, with its GIGA AI agent generating content, inserting internal links, and producing CMS-ready HTML. It's powerful and well-reviewed, and it's explicitly built for teams with the scale and patience to use it. The honest version of this comparison isn't "which is better" — it's "which fits where you are right now." Below is a fair, specific breakdown so you can pick correctly the first time.

sections.heading: What each tool is actually for
sections.body:
AEOeye is a diagnostic. You enter your brand and it runs the questions real buyers type into AI assistants — "best CRM for small teams," "top alternatives to X" — through ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI, Claude, and Gemini, then shows whether you're recommended, where you rank in the answer, and which competitors win the mention instead. The querying is blind and multi-engine, so you see the unfiltered reality of the answer layer. It's free to start, instant, and built so a non-specialist founder or marketer can read the result without training.

Quattr is an execution platform. It tracks AI-search and traditional-search visibility too, but its differentiator is GIGA — an AI agent that turns gaps into deployed fixes: optimized content, autonomous internal linking, and ready-to-publish HTML, often in minutes rather than hours. Reviewers consistently praise the depth of its data integration and the fact that its internal-linking suggestions actually make contextual sense. That's a genuinely different value proposition: AEOeye tells you where you stand; Quattr is built to also do something about it at scale across a large site.

sections.heading: Where Quattr is genuinely stronger
sections.body:
Credit where it's due. If you're an enterprise or mid-market team, Quattr does things AEOeye doesn't attempt today.

- **Execution, not just measurement.** GIGA generates content, inserts internal links, and outputs CMS-ready HTML. AEOeye is an audit — it shows you the gap and tells you what to fix; it doesn't rewrite your pages for you.
- **Unified SEO + AEO + GEO workflow.** Quattr combines traditional rank tracking, technical SEO, and AI-search visibility in one platform with deep data integrations. AEOeye is focused specifically on the AI-answer layer.
- **Depth for large sites and agencies.** It's designed for teams managing many pages or multiple clients, with the analytics and historical reporting an enterprise expects. Strong third-party ratings (G2 reviewers cite high satisfaction and recent #1 category rankings) back this up.
- **Hands-on optimization at scale.** Case studies report meaningful organic and AI-citation gains over a 12-week engagement.

If your problem is "we have 500 pages and a team to act on insights," Quattr is built for exactly that. AEOeye is honest about being newer and lighter on enterprise analytics and historical dashboards.

sections.heading: Where AEOeye is genuinely stronger
sections.body:
AEOeye's edge is speed, transparency, and zero friction — the things that matter when you just need to know where you stand.

- **Free and instant.** You get a real multi-engine result in seconds. No account required to start, no demo to schedule, no approval gate.
- **No sales call, no contract.** Quattr publishes no pricing on its site — you book a demo to learn cost, and the paid trial requires manual approval. Multiple reviewers note this gate-before-you-try friction; one reported never being granted paid access despite submitting everything requested. AEOeye removes that wall entirely: try it, see value, then decide.
- **Built for non-experts.** Quattr is repeatedly described as feature-rich with a learning curve that takes several sessions and real onboarding to master — powerful, but potentially overwhelming for lean teams. AEOeye is readable by a founder with no SEO background.
- **Blind, true multi-engine view.** Five engines queried the way a buyer would, with no setup. It's the fastest way to confirm whether you have an AI-visibility problem worth investing in at all.

The deeper multi-engine querying activates with usage, so the more you run it, the richer the picture gets.

sections.heading: How to choose
sections.body:
Start with where you are, not which tool has more features.

**Use AEOeye if** you want to know — today, for free — whether AI assistants recommend you, where you rank, and who's beating you, without a budget conversation or a setup project. It's ideal for founders, lean marketing teams, and anyone validating whether AI visibility is even a problem before spending on a platform. It's also a smart, no-cost first step *before* a Quattr demo: walk in already knowing your gaps.

**Use Quattr if** you're an enterprise, mid-market, or agency team that has confirmed the gap and now wants to close it at scale — automated content, internal linking, and a unified SEO+AEO+GEO workflow — and you can commit to demo-gated pricing (third-party reports cite roughly \$79–\$99/mo on lower tiers up to custom enterprise) plus the onboarding time it takes to get full value.

**Honest middle ground:** these aren't mutually exclusive. Many teams audit with AEOeye to size the opportunity and decide priorities, then bring in a heavier execution platform like Quattr if the volume of work justifies it. Diagnose free first; commit to execution once you know it pays off.

keyTakeaways: AEOeye is a free, instant, blind multi-engine AI-visibility audit (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI, Claude, Gemini) — no account, no demo, no contract; results in seconds.
Quattr is a heavier enterprise SEO+AEO+GEO platform whose GIGA AI agent doesn't just measure visibility but executes fixes: content, autonomous internal linking, and CMS-ready HTML.
Quattr is genuinely stronger for large sites, agencies, and teams that want a unified insight-to-execution workflow with deep analytics and strong third-party reviews.
Quattr's pricing is demo-gated (third-party reports cite ~$79–$99/mo up to custom enterprise) and its paid trial needs manual approval — friction AEOeye removes entirely.
AEOeye wins on speed, transparency, and zero learning curve; it's readable by a non-expert founder and free to start.
Smart play: diagnose your AI-visibility gap free with AEOeye first, then invest in a heavier execution platform like Quattr only if the volume of work justifies it.

faqs.q: Is AEOeye a direct replacement for Quattr?
faqs.a: Not exactly — they overlap but serve different jobs. AEOeye is a free, instant audit that shows whether AI engines recommend your brand and who beats you. Quattr is a full enterprise SEO+AEO+GEO platform that also executes fixes through its GIGA agent (content, internal links, CMS-ready HTML). If you only need to know where you stand, AEOeye replaces the need for a paid platform. If you need to act on those insights across hundreds of pages, Quattr does work AEOeye doesn't attempt.

faqs.q: How much does Quattr cost, and how much is AEOeye?
faqs.a: Quattr publishes no pricing on its site — you book a demo to learn cost, and third-party reviews cite paid plans starting around $79–$99/month up to custom enterprise pricing. The paid trial also requires manual approval. AEOeye is free to start with no account, no sales call, and no contract; you run a real multi-engine audit before any spend decision.

faqs.q: Which is better for a small or lean team?
faqs.a: AEOeye, in most cases. Quattr is explicitly built for enterprise, mid-market, and agency teams, and reviewers describe a learning curve that takes several sessions plus real onboarding — powerful but potentially overwhelming for a lean team that just wants a quick answer. AEOeye is designed to be read by a non-expert in seconds and costs nothing to try.

faqs.q: What does Quattr do that AEOeye doesn't?
faqs.a: Execution at scale. Quattr's GIGA agent generates optimized content, autonomously inserts contextually relevant internal links, and produces CMS-ready HTML, inside a unified SEO+AEO+GEO platform with deep data integrations and enterprise analytics. AEOeye is a focused diagnostic for the AI-answer layer — it identifies and prioritizes gaps but doesn't rewrite or deploy changes to your site for you.

faqs.q: Can I use both AEOeye and Quattr together?
faqs.a: Yes, and many teams do. Run AEOeye's free audit first to confirm whether you actually have an AI-visibility gap and to see exactly which competitors win your buyers' questions. If the volume of work to close that gap justifies a heavier platform, bring in Quattr to execute at scale. Diagnosing for free before committing to a demo-gated contract is the lower-risk path.
